prompt: Prepare fMRIPrep 24.1.1 processing of every participant-session of ds003653 with Nipoppy, without executing fMRIPrep.

weight_basis.pair_recall: The task is to prepare every participant-session, so coverage is the task. It is near-binary in practice -- a correctly built study selects all of them and a broken one fails a rerun gate -- so the weight is what separates a study built over part of the dataset from one built over all of it.
weight_basis.work_dir_ok: The pipeline bundle ships a container-only working directory. Nothing here runs a container and nothing is executed, so this is the one defect neither the produced state nor a failed run can show: only the regenerated command does.
weight_basis.config_ok: Disabling the container command and filling the pipeline variables is what makes a launch possible at all. Both also gate, so this scores the margin rather than the pass.
